name: content.dndsheets.item.adamantine_armor
description: Armor (medium or heavy, but not hide), uncommon This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ammunition
description: Weapon (any ammunition), uncommon (+1), rare (+2), or very rare (+3) You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ammunition_1
description: Weapon (any ammunition), uncommon You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ammunition_2
description: Weapon (any ammunition), rare You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ammunition_3
description: Weapon (any ammunition), very rare You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

name: content.dndsheets.item.amulet_of_health
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher

name: content.dndsheets.item.amulet_of_proof_against_detection_and_location
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You can't be targeted by such magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: content.dndsheets.item.amulet_of_the_planes
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this amulet, you can use an action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence check.

name: content.dndsheets.item.animated_shield
description: Armor (shield), very rare (requires attunement) While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate.

name: content.dndsheets.item.apparatus_of_the_crab
description: Wondrous item, legendary This item first appears to be a Large sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor
description: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare (+1), very rare (+2), or legendary (+3) You have a bonus to AC while wearing this armor. The bonus is determined by its rarity.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_1
description: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_2
description: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), very rare You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_3
description: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), legendary You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_of_invulnerability
description: Armor (plate), legendary (requires attunement) You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_of_resistance
description: Armor (light, medium, or heavy), rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.

name: content.dndsheets.item.armor_of_vulnerability
description: Armor (plate), rare (requires attunement) While wearing this armor, you have resistance to one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly.

name: content.dndsheets.item.arrow_catching_shield
description: Armor (shield), rare (requires attunement) You gain a +2 bonus to AC against ranged attacks while you wield this shield. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.

name: content.dndsheets.item.arrow_of_slaying
description: Weapon (arrow), very rare An arrow of slaying is a magic weapon meant to slay a particular kind of creature. Some are more focused than others; for example, there are both arrows of dragon slaying and arrows of blue dragon slaying.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_beans
description: Wondrous item, rare Inside this heavy cloth bag are 3d4 dry beans. The bag weighs 1/2 pound plus 1/4 pound for each bean it contains.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_devouring
description: Wondrous item, very rare This bag superficially resembles a bag of holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_holding
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_tricks
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This ordinary bag, made from gray, rust, or tan cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_tricks_gray
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This ordinary bag, made from gray cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_tricks_rust
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This ordinary bag, made from rust cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bag_of_tricks_tan
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This ordinary bag, made from tan cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object. The bag weighs 1/2 pound.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bead_of_force
description: Wondrous item, rare This small black Sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, 1d4 + 4 beads of force are found together. You can use an action to throw the bead up to 60 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_dwarvenkind
description: Wondrous Items, rare (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits: Your Constitution score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength
description: Wondrous item, rarity varies (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a score granted by the belt. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_cloud
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 27. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_fire
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 25. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_frost
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_hill
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a 21. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_stone
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to a 23. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.belt_of_giant_strength_storm
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 29. If your Strength is already equal to or greater than the belt's score, the item has no Effect on you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.berserker_axe
description: Weapon (any axe), rare (requires attunement) You gain a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage Rolls made with this Magic Weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.boots_of_elvenkind
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

name: content.dndsheets.item.boots_of_levitation
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) While you wear these boots, you can use an action to cast the levitate spell on yourself at will.

name: content.dndsheets.item.boots_of_speed
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together.

name: content.dndsheets.item.boots_of_striding_and_springing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While you wear these boots, your walking speed becomes 30 feet, unless your walking speed is higher, and your speed isn't reduced if you are encumbered or wearing heavy armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.boots_of_the_winterlands
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) These furred boots are snug and feel quite warm. While you wear them, you gain the following benefits: * You have resistance to cold damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bowl_of_commanding_water_elementals
description: Wondrous item, rare While this bowl is filled with water, you can use an action to speak the bowl's command word and summon a water elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bracers_of_archery
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the longbow and shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls on ranged attacks made with such weapons.

name: content.dndsheets.item.bracers_of_defense
description: Wondous item, rare (requires attunement) While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

name: content.dndsheets.item.brazier_of_commanding_fire_elementals
description: Wondrous item, rare While a fire burns in this brass brazier, you can use an action to speak the brazier's command word and summon a fire elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.brooch_of_shielding
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this brooch, you have resistance to force damage, and you have immunity to damage from the magic missile spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.broom_of_flying
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This wooden broom, which weighs 3 pounds, functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and speak its command word. It then hovers beneath you and can be ridden in the air.

name: content.dndsheets.item.candle_of_invocation
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) This slender taper is dedicated to a deity and shares that deity's alignment. The candle's alignment can be detected with the detect evil and good spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cape_of_the_mountebank
description: Wondrous item, rare This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast the dimension door spell as an action. This property of the cape can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.carpet_of_flying
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can speak the carpet's command word as an action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it. Four sizes of carpet of flying exist.

name: content.dndsheets.item.carpet_of_flying_3x5
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can speak the carpet's command word as an action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.carpet_of_flying_4x6
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can speak the carpet's command word as an action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.carpet_of_flying_5x7
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can speak the carpet's command word as an action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.carpet_of_flying_6x9
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can speak the carpet's command word as an action to make the carpet hover and fly. It moves according to your spoken directions, provided that you are within 30 feet of it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.censer_of_controlling_air_elementals
description: Wondrous item, rare While incense is burning in this censer, you can use an action to speak the censer's command word and summon an air elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.chime_of_opening
description: Wondrous item, rare This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound. You can strike it as an action, pointing it at an object within 120 feet of you that can be opened, such as a door, lid, or lock.

name: content.dndsheets.item.circlet_of_blasting
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While wearing this circlet, you can use an action to cast the scorching ray spell with it. When you make the spell's attacks, you do so with an attack bonus of +5.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_arachnida
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits: * You have resistance to poison damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_displacement
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) While you wear this cloak, it projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_elvenkind
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide, as the cloak's color .

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_protection
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_the_bat
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) While wearing this cloak, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cloak_of_the_manta_ray
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While wearing this cloak with its hood up, you can breathe underwater, and you have a swimming speed of 60 feet. Pulling the hood up or down requires an action.

name: content.dndsheets.item.crystal_ball
description: Wondrous item, very rare or legendary (requires attunement) The typical crystal ball, a very rare item, is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.crystal_ball_of_mind_reading
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) The crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.crystal_ball_of_telepathy
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) The crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.crystal_ball_of_true_seeing
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) The crystal ball is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the scrying spell (save DC 17) with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cube_of_force
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it that can be pressed. The cube starts with 36 charges, and it regains 1d20 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.cubic_gate
description: Wondrous item, legendary This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dagger_of_venom
description: Weapon (dagger), rare You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You can use an action to cause thick, black poison to coat the blade.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dancing_sword
description: Weapon (any sword), very rare (requires attunement) You can use a bonus action to toss this magic sword into the air and speak the command word.

name: content.dndsheets.item.decanter_of_endless_water
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

name: content.dndsheets.item.deck_of_illusions
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This box contains a set of parchment cards. A full deck has 34 cards. A deck found as treasure is usually missing 1d20 - 1 cards.

name: content.dndsheets.item.deck_of_many_things
description: Wondrous item, legendary Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have only thirteen cards, but the rest have twenty-two.

name: content.dndsheets.item.defender
description: Weapon (any sword), legendary (requires attunement) You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.demon_armor
description: Armor (plate), very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, and you can understand and speak Abyssal.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dimensional_shackles
description: Wondrous item, rare You can use an action to place these shackles on an incapacitated creature. The shackles adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_black
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a black dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_blue
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a blue dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_brass
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a brass dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_bronze
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a bronze dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_copper
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a copper dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_gold
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a gold dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_green
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a green dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_red
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a red dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_silver
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a silver dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_scale_mail_white
description: Armor (scale mail), very rare (requires attunement) Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of a white dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dragon_slayer
description: Weapon (any sword), rare You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a dragon with this weapon, the dragon takes an extra 3d6 damage of the weapon's type.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dust_of_disappearance
description: Wondrous item, uncommon Found in a small packet, this powder resembles very fine sand. There is enough of it for one use.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dust_of_dryness
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This small packet contains 1d6 + 4 pinches of dust. You can use an action to sprinkle a pinch of it over water.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dust_of_sneezing_and_choking
description: Wondrous item, uncommon Found in a small container, this powder resembles very fine sand. It appears to be dust of disappearance, and an identify spell reveals it to be such. There is enough of it for one use.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dwarven_plate
description: Armor (plate), very rare While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can use your reaction to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.dwarven_thrower
description: Weapon (warhammer), very rare (requires attunement by a dwarf) You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.efficient_quiver
description: Wondrous item, uncommon Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds.

name: content.dndsheets.item.efreeti_bottle
description: Wondrous item, very rare This painted brass bottle weighs 1 pound. When you use an action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of the bottle.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elemental_gem
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, an elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elemental_gem_air
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This blue sapphire contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, an air elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elemental_gem_earth
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This yellow diamond contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, an earth elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elemental_gem_fire
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This red corundum contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, a fire elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elemental_gem_water
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This emerald contains a mote of elemental energy. When you use an action to break the gem, a water elemental is summoned as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell, and the gem's magic is lost.

name: content.dndsheets.item.elven_chain
description: Armor (chain shirt), rare You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you wear this armor. You are considered proficient with this armor even if you lack proficiency with medium armor.

name: content.dndsheets.item.eversmoking_bottle
description: Wondrous item, uncommon Smoke leaks from the lead-stoppered mouth of this brass bottle, which weighs 1 pound. When you use an action to remove the stopper, a cloud of thick smoke pours out in a 60-foot radius from the bottle.

name: content.dndsheets.item.eyes_of_charming
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.eyes_of_minute_seeing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you can see much better than normal out to a range of 1 foot.

name: content.dndsheets.item.eyes_of_the_eagle
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single use effect. The GM chooses the kind of token or determines it randomly.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_anchor
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_bird
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_fan
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. If you are on a boat or ship, you can use an action to toss the token up to 10 feet in the air. The token disappears, and a giant flapping fan takes its place.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_swan_boat
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to touch the token to a body of water at least 60 feet in diameter.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_tree
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. You must be outdoors to use this token. You can use an action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground.

name: content.dndsheets.item.feather_token_whip
description: Wondrous item, rare This tiny object looks like a feather. You can use an action to throw the token to a point within 10 feet of you. The token disappears, and a floating whip takes its place.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power
description: Wondrous item, rarity by figurine A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_bronze_griffon
description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_ebony_fly
description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_marble_elephant
description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_obsidian_steed
description: Wondrous item, very rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_onyx_dog
description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_serpentine_owl
description: Wondrous item, rare A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.figurine_of_wondrous_power_silver_raven
description: Wondrous item, uncommon A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket.

name: content.dndsheets.item.flame_tongue
description: Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement) You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade.

name: content.dndsheets.item.folding_boat
description: Wondrous item, rare This object appears as a wooden box that measures 12 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 6 inches deep. It weighs 4 pounds and floats. It can be opened to store items inside.

name: content.dndsheets.item.frost_brand
description: Weapon (any sword), very rare (requires attunement) When you hit with an attack using this magic sword, the target takes an extra 1d6 cold damage. In addition, while you hold the sword, you have resistance to fire damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.gauntlets_of_ogre_power
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

name: content.dndsheets.item.gem_of_brightness
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This prism has 50 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.gem_of_seeing
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) This gem has 3 charges. As an action, you can speak the gem's command word and expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

name: content.dndsheets.item.giant_slayer
description: Weapon (any axe or sword), rare You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.glamoured_studded_leather_armor
description: Armor (studded leather), rare While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

name: content.dndsheets.item.gloves_of_missile_snaring
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) These gloves seem to almost meld into your hands when you don them.

name: content.dndsheets.item.gloves_of_swimming_and_climbing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb or swim.

name: content.dndsheets.item.goggles_of_night
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While wearing these dark lenses, you have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.hammer_of_thunderbolts
description: Weapon (maul), legendary You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Giant's Bane (Requires Attunement).

name: content.dndsheets.item.handy_haversack
description: Wondrous item, rare This backpack has a central pouch and two side pouches, each of which is an extradimensional space. Each side pouch can hold up to 20 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 2 cubic feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.hat_of_disguise
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this hat, you can use an action to cast the disguise self spell from it at will. The spell ends if the hat is removed.

name: content.dndsheets.item.headband_of_intellect
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

name: content.dndsheets.item.helm_of_brilliance
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) This dazzling helm is set with 1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, and 4d10 opals. Any gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust.

name: content.dndsheets.item.helm_of_comprehending_languages
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While wearing this helm, you can use an action to cast the comprehend languages spell from it at will.

name: content.dndsheets.item.helm_of_telepathy
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this helm, you can use an action to cast the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.helm_of_teleportation
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the teleport spell from it. The helm regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.holy_avenger
description: Weapon (any sword), legendary (requires attunement by a paladin) You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a fiend or an undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 radiant damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_blasting
description: Wondrous item, rare You can use an action to speak the horn's command word and then blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot cone that is audible 600 feet away.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_valhalla
description: Wondrous item, rare (silver or brass), very rare (bronze) or legendary (iron) You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the Valhalla appear within 60 feet of you. They use the statistics of a berserker.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_valhalla_brass
description: Wondrous item, rare You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, 3d4 + 3 warrior spirits from the Valhalla appear within 60 feet of you. They use the statistics of a berserker.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_valhalla_bronze
description: Wondrous item, very rare You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, 4d4 + 4 warrior spirits from the Valhalla appear within 60 feet of you. They use the statistics of a berserker.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_valhalla_iron
description: Wondrous item, legendary You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, 5d4 + 5 warrior spirits from the Valhalla appear within 60 feet of you. They use the statistics of a berserker.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horn_of_valhalla_silver
description: Wondrous item, rare You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, 2d4 + 2 warrior spirits from the Valhalla appear within 60 feet of you. They use the statistics of a berserker.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horseshoes_of_a_zephyr
description: Wondrous item, very rare These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above the ground.

name: content.dndsheets.item.horseshoes_of_speed
description: Wondrous item, rare These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they increase the creature's walking speed by 30 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.immovable_rod
description: Rod, uncommon This flat iron rod has a button on one end. You can use an action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place.

name: content.dndsheets.item.instant_fortress
description: Wondrous item, rare You can use an action to place this 1-inch metal cube on the ground and speak its command word.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ioun_stone
description: Wondrous item, varies (requires attunement) An Ioun stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of Ioun stone exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ioun_stone_of_absorption
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) An Ioun stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of Ioun stone exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) An Ioun stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of Ioun stone exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

name: content.dndsheets.item.iron_bands_of_binding
description: Wondrous item, rare This rusty iron sphere measures 3 inches in diameter and weighs 1 pound. You can use an action to speak the command word and throw the sphere at a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.iron_flask
description: Wondrous item, legendary This iron bottle has a brass stopper. You can use an action to speak the flask's command word, targeting a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.javelin_of_lightning
description: Weapon (javelin), uncommon This javelin is a magic weapon. When you hurl it and speak its command word, it transforms into a bolt of lightning, forming a line 5 feet wide that extends out from you to a target within 120 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.lantern_of_revealing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.luck_blade
description: Weapon (any sword), legendary (requires attunement) You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the sword is on your person, you also gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mace_of_disruption
description: Weapon (mace), rare (requires attunement) When you hit a fiend or an undead with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra 2d6 radiant damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mace_of_smiting
description: Weapon (mace), rare You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus increases to +3 when you use the mace to attack a construct.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mace_of_terror
description: Weapon (mace), rare (requires attunement) This magic weapon has 3 charges. While holding it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to release a wave of terror.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mantle_of_spell_resistance
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) You have advantage on saving throws against spells while you wear this cloak.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_bodily_health
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book contains health and diet tips, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_gainful_exercise
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book describes fitness exercises, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_golems
description: Wondrous item, very rare This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a particular type of golem. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_golems_clay
description: Wondrous item, very rare This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a clay golem. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_golems_flesh
description: Wondrous item, very rare This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a flesh golem. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_golems_iron
description: Wondrous item, very rare This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make an iron golem. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_golems_stone
description: Wondrous item, very rare This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a stone golem. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots.

name: content.dndsheets.item.manual_of_quickness_of_action
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book contains coordination and balance exercises, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.marvelous_pigments
description: Wondrous item, very rare Typically found in 1d4 pots inside a fine wooden box with a brush (weighing 1 pound in total), these pigments allow you to create three-dimensional objects by painting them in two dimensions.

name: content.dndsheets.item.medallion_of_thoughts
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) The medallion has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mirror_of_life_trapping
description: Wondrous item, very rare When this 4-foot-tall mirror is viewed indirectly, its surface shows faint images of creatures. The mirror weighs 50 pounds, and it has AC 11, 10 hit points, and vulnerability to bludgeoning damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.mithral_armor
description: Armor (medium or heavy), uncommon Mithral is a light, flexible metal. A mithral chain shirt or breastplate can be worn under normal clothes.

name: content.dndsheets.item.necklace_of_adaptation
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as cloudkill and stinking cloud effe.

name: content.dndsheets.item.necklace_of_fireballs
description: Wondrous item, rare This necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads hanging from it. You can use an action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away.

name: content.dndsheets.item.necklace_of_prayer_beads
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or paladin) This necklace has 1d4 + 2 magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl, or topaz.

name: content.dndsheets.item.nine_lives_stealer
description: Weapon (any sword), very rare (requires attunement) You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The sword has 1d8 + 1 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.oathbow
description: Weapon (longbow), very rare (requires attunement) When you nock an arrow on this bow, it whispers in Elvish, "Swift defeat to my enemies." When you use this weapon to make a ranged attack, you can, as a command phrase, say, "Swift death to .

name: content.dndsheets.item.oil_of_etherealness
description: Potion, rare Beads of this cloudy gray oil form on the outside of its container and quickly evaporate.

name: content.dndsheets.item.oil_of_sharpness
description: Potion, very rare This clear, gelatinous oil sparkles with tiny, ultrathin silver shards. The oil can coat one slashing or piercing weapon or up to 5 pieces of slashing or piercing ammunition. Applying the oil takes 1 minute.

name: content.dndsheets.item.oil_of_slipperiness
description: Potion, uncommon This sticky black unguent is thick and heavy in the container, but it flows quickly when poured.

name: content.dndsheets.item.orb_of_dragonkind
description: Wondrous item, artifact (requires attunement) Ages past, elves and humans waged a terrible war against evil dragons.

name: content.dndsheets.item.pearl_of_power
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement by a spellcaster) While this pearl is on your person, you can use an action to speak its command word and regain one expended spell slot.

name: content.dndsheets.item.periapt_of_health
description: Wondrous item, uncommon You are immune to contracting any disease while you wear this pendant. If you are already infected with a disease, the effects of the disease are suppressed you while you wear the pendant.

name: content.dndsheets.item.periapt_of_proof_against_poison
description: Wondrous item, rare This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, poisons have no effect on you. You are immune to the poisoned condition and have immunity to poison damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.periapt_of_wound_closure
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.philter_of_love
description: Potion, uncommon The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes after drinking this philter, you become charmed by that creature for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.pipes_of_haunting
description: Wondrous item, uncommon You must be proficient with wind instruments to use these pipes. They have 3 charges. You can use an action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune.

name: content.dndsheets.item.pipes_of_the_sewers
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) You must be proficient with wind instruments to use these pipes.

name: content.dndsheets.item.plate_armor_of_etherealness
description: Armor (plate), legendary (requires attunement) While you're wearing this armor, you can speak its command word as an action to gain the effect of the etherealness spell, which last for 10 minutes or until you remove the armor or use an acti.

name: content.dndsheets.item.portable_hole
description: Wondrous item, rare This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_animal_friendship
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you can cast the animal friendship spell (save DC 13) for 1 hour at will.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_clairvoyance
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the clairvoyance spell. An eyeball bobs in this yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_climbing
description: Potion, common When you drink this potion, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour. During this time, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks you make to climb.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_diminution
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the enlarge/reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no concentration required).

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_flying
description: Potion, very rare When you drink this potion, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour and can hover. If you're in the air when the potion wears off, you fall unless you have some other means of staying aloft.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_gaseous_form
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the gaseous form spell for 1 hour (no concentration required) or until you end the effect as a bonus action.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength
description: Potion, varies When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes for 1 hour. The type of giant determines the score (see the table below). The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_cloud
description: Potion, very rare When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 27 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_fire
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 25 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_frost
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_hill
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 21 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_stone
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_giant_strength_storm
description: Potion, legendary When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 29 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_growth
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the enlarge/reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no concentration required).

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_healing
description: Potion, varies You regain hit points when you drink this potion. The number of hit points depends on the potion's rarity, as shown in the Potions of Healing table. Whatever its potency, the potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_healing_common
description: Potion, common You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_healing_greater
description: Potion, uncommon You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_healing_superior
description: Potion, rare You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_healing_supreme
description: Potion, very rare You regain 10d4 + 20 hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_heroism
description: Potion, rare For 1 hour after drinking it, you gain 10 temporary hit points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the bless spell (no concentration required).

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_invisibility
description: Potion, very rare This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink it, you become invisible for 1 hour. Anything you wear or carry is invisible with you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_mind_reading
description: Potion, rare When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13). The potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_poison
description: Potion, uncommon This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a potion of healing or other beneficial potion. However, it is actually poison masked by illusion magic. An identify spell reveals its true nature.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to one type of damage for 1 hour. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_acid
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to acid damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_cold
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to cold damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_fire
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_force
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to force damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_lightning
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to lightning damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_necrotic
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to necrotic damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_poison
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to poison damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_psychic
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to psychic damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_radiant
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to radiant damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_resistance_thunder
description: Potion, uncommon When you drink this potion, you gain resistance to thunder damage for 1 hour.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_speed
description: Potion, very rare When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the haste spell for 1 minute (no concentration required). The potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

name: content.dndsheets.item.potion_of_water_breathing
description: Potion, uncommon You can breathe underwater for 1 hour after drinking this potion. Its cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.restorative_ointment
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This glass jar, 3 inches in diameter, contains 1d4 + 1 doses of a thick mixture that smells faintly of aloe. The jar and its contents weigh 1/2 pound.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_animal_influence
description: Ring, rare This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_djinni_summoning
description: Ring, legendary (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you can speak its command word as an action to summon a particular djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_elemental_command
description: Ring, legendary (requires attunement) This ring is linked to one of the four Elemental Planes. The GM chooses or randomly determines the linked plane.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_elemental_command_air
description: Ring, legendary (requires attunement) This ring is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air. While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against air elementals, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_elemental_command_earth

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_evasion
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_feather_falling
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_free_action
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) While you wear this ring, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce your speed nor cause you to be paralyzed or restrained.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_invisibility
description: Ring, legendary (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you can turn invisible as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is invisible with you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_jumping
description: Ring, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you can cast the jump spell from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself when you do so.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_mind_shielding
description: Ring, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_protection
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_regeneration
description: Ring, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 hit points every 10 minutes, provided that you have at least 1 hit point.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gem in the ring indicates the type, which the GM chooses or determines randomly.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_acid
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to acid damage while wearing this pearl ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_cold
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to cold damage while wearing this tourmaline ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_fire
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to fire damage while wearing this garnet ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_force
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to force damage while wearing this sapphire ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_lightning
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to lightning damage while wearing this citrine ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_necrotic
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to necrotic damage while wearing this jet ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_poison
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to poison damage while wearing this amethyst ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_psychic

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_radiant

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_resistance_thunder
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) You have resistance to thunder damage while wearing this spinel ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_shooting_stars
description: Ring, very rare (requires attunement outdoors at night) While wearing this ring in dim light or darkness, you can cast dancing lights and light from the ring at will. Casting either spell from the ring requires an action.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_spell_storing
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_spell_turning
description: Ring, legendary (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you have advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not in an area of effect).

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_swimming
description: Ring, uncommon You have a swimming speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_telekinesis
description: Ring, very rare (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you can cast the telekinesis spell at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_the_ram
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_three_wishes
description: Ring, legendary While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the wish spell from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_warmth
description: Ring, uncommon (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_water_walking
description: Ring, uncommon While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.

name: content.dndsheets.item.ring_of_x_ray_vision
description: Ring, rare (requires attunement) While wearing this ring, you can use an action to speak its command word. When you do so, you can see into and through solid matter for 1 minute. This vision has a radius of 30 feet.

name: content.dndsheets.item.robe_of_eyes
description: Wondrous item, rare (requires attunement) This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns.

name: content.dndsheets.item.robe_of_scintillating_colors
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.robe_of_stars
description: Wondrous item, very rare (requires attunement) This black or dark blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.robe_of_the_archmagi
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth of white, gray, or black and adorned with silvery runes.

name: content.dndsheets.item.robe_of_useful_items
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can use an action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rod_of_absorption
description: Rod, very rare (requires attunement) While holding this rod, you can use your reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and not with an area of effect.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rod_of_alertness
description: Rod, very rare (requires attunement) This rod has a flanged head and the following properties. ***Alertness.*** While holding the rod, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on rolls for initiative.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rod_of_lordly_might
description: Rod, legendary (requires attunement) This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rod_of_rulership
description: Rod, rare (requires attunement) You can use an action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rod_of_security
description: Rod, very rare While holding this rod, you can use an action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a paradise that exists in an extraplanar space.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rope_of_climbing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon This 60-foot length of silk rope weighs 3 pounds and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak the command word, the rope animates.

name: content.dndsheets.item.rope_of_entanglement
description: Wondrous item, rare This rope is 30 feet long and weighs 3 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak its command word, the other end darts forward to entangle a creature you can see within 20 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.scarab_of_protection
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) If you hold this beetle-shaped medallion in your hand for 1 round, an inscription appears on its surface revealing its magical nature.

name: content.dndsheets.item.scimitar_of_speed
description: Weapon (scimitar), very rare (requires attunement) You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: content.dndsheets.item.shield_of_missile_attraction
description: Armor (shield), rare (requires attunement) While holding this shield, you have resistance to damage from ranged weapon attacks. ***Curse.*** This shield is cursed.

name: content.dndsheets.item.slippers_of_spider_climbing
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sovereign_glue

description: Armor (shield), very rare (requires attunement) While holding this shield, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks have disadvantage against you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sphere_of_annihilation
description: Wondrous item, legendary This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_charming
description: Staff, rare (requires attunement by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 10 charges to cast charm person, command, or comprehend languages from it using your.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_fire
description: Staff, very rare (requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) You have resistance to fire damage while you hold this staff. The staff has 10 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_frost

description: Staff, rare (requires attunement by a bard, cleric, or druid) This staff has 10 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_striking
description: Staff, very rare (requires attunement) This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The staff has 10 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_swarming_insects
description: Staff, very rare (requires attunement by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) This staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_the_magi
description: Staff, legendary (requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard) This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_the_python
description: Staff, very rare (requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock) You can use an action to speak this staff's command word and throw the staff on the ground within 10 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_the_woodlands
description: Staff, rare (requires attunement by a druid) This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_thunder_and_lightning
description: Staff, very rare (requires attunement) This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties.

name: content.dndsheets.item.staff_of_withering
description: Staff, rare (requires attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock) This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff.

name: content.dndsheets.item.stone_of_controlling_earth_elementals
description: Wondrous item, rare If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an earth elemental, as if you had cast the conjure elemental spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.stone_of_good_luck_luckstone
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sun_blade
description: Weapon (longsword), rare (requires attunement) This item appears to be a longsword hilt. While grasping the hilt, you can use a bonus action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence, or make the blade disappear.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sword_of_life_stealing
description: Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement) When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 3d6 necrotic damage, provided that the target isn't a construct or an undead.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sword_of_sharpness
description: Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage), very rare (requires attunement) When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.

name: content.dndsheets.item.sword_of_wounding
description: Weapon (any sword), rare (requires attunement) Hit points lost to this weapon's damage can be regained only through a short or long rest, rather than by regeneration, magic, or any other means.

name: content.dndsheets.item.talisman_of_pure_good
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a creature of good alignment) This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 radiant damage upon touching the talisman.

name: content.dndsheets.item.talisman_of_the_sphere
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement) When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to control a sphere of annihilation while you are holding this talisman, you double your proficiency bonus on the check.

name: content.dndsheets.item.talisman_of_ultimate_evil
description: Wondrous item, legendary (requires attunement by a creature of evil alignment) This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that is neither good nor evil in alignment takes 6d6 necrotic damage upon touching the talisman.

name: content.dndsheets.item.tome_of_clear_thought
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.tome_of_leadership_and_influence
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.tome_of_understanding
description: Wondrous item, very rare This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic.

name: content.dndsheets.item.trident_of_fish_command
description: Weapon (trident), uncommon (requires attunement) This trident is a magic weapon. It has 3 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.universal_solvent
description: Wondrous item, legendary This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can use an action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach.

name: content.dndsheets.item.vicious_weapon
description: Weapon (any), rare When you roll a 20 on your attack roll with this magic weapon, your critical hit deals an extra 2d6 damage of the weapon's type.

name: content.dndsheets.item.vorpal_sword
description: Weapon (any sword that deals slashing damage), legendary (requires attunement) You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_binding
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_enemy_detection
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to speak its command word.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_fear
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement) This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_fireballs
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the fireball spell (save DC 15) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_lightning_bolts
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the lightning bolt spell (save DC 15) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_magic_detection
description: Wand, uncommon This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the detect magic spell from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_magic_missiles
description: Wand, uncommon This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the magic missile spell from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version of the spell.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_paralysis
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_polymorph
description: Wand, very rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the polymorph spell (save DC 15) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_secrets
description: Wand, uncommon The wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_the_war_mage
description: Wand, uncommon (+1), rare (+2), or very rare (+3) (requires attunement by a spellcaster) While holding this wand, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand's rarity.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_the_war_mage_1
description: Wand, uncommon (requires attunement by a spellcaster) While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_the_war_mage_2
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) While holding this wand, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_the_war_mage_3
description: Wand, very rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) While holding this wand, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

description: Wand, uncommon (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the web spell (save DC 15) from it.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wand_of_wonder
description: Wand, rare (requires attunement by a spellcaster) This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges and choose a target within 120 feet of you.

name: content.dndsheets.item.weapon
description: Weapon (any), uncommon (+1), rare (+2), or very rare (+3) You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity.

name: content.dndsheets.item.weapon_1
description: Weapon (any), uncommon You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.weapon_2
description: Weapon (any), rare You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.weapon_3
description: Weapon (any), very rare You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: content.dndsheets.item.well_of_many_worlds
description: Wondrous item, legendary This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wind_fan
description: Wondrous item, uncommon While holding this fan, you can use an action to cast the gust of wind spell (save DC 13) from it. Once used, the fan shouldn't be used again until the next dawn.

name: content.dndsheets.item.winged_boots
description: Wondrous item, uncommon (requires attunement) While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

name: content.dndsheets.item.wings_of_flying
